eligibility_evidence: Position Overview The IT Network Engineer designs, secures, implements, and maintains a reliable, highly available hybrid network across Vivmark Residential's datacenters, corporate offices, residential properties, and public cloud environments.
Work Schedule: This position requires onsite attendance Monday through Thursday, with remote work permitted on Fridays.

Cloud and Hybrid Networking Designs, implements, and supports hybrid connectivity between on-premises infrastructure and public cloud environments, including Azure ExpressRoute, VPN gateways, hub-and-spoke virtual networks, Private Link, AWS Direct Connect, and Transit Gateway.
Configures and maintains BGP routing policies and network segmentation to support secure, reliable hybrid connectivity.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: This role requires extensive expertise in enterprise routing and switching across Cisco (including Meraki), Juniper, and Arista platforms, along with working knowledge of Palo Alto firewalls, application delivery technologies (F5 Distributed Cloud and Cloudflare), cloud networking (Azure and AWS), and DDI (DNS, DHCP, and IP address management). The engineer anticipates emerging technology trends, including SASE and zero trust networking, and recommends solutions that support current and future business requirements. The successful candidate's starting pay will be determined based on job-related skills, experience, and qualifications. Researches emerging technologies, evaluates potential solutions, and recommends infrastructure improvements that meet business and technical requirements.
